relevance_note: Single-patient case letter of a girl with a diagnosis of LAD confirmed by reduced CD18 ("CD18 positivity on neutrophils was markedly reduced (1.48 vs 99.97% in control) and confirmed diagnosis of LAD"); no ITGB2 variant is reported, so she is in scope by diagnosis only.
method_note: Read by hand; no script transcribed tables (the paper has none). The paper says 'leukocyte adhesion deficiency (LAD)', never 'type I' or ITGB2; the person is included on the CD18-confirmed LAD diagnosis, which is an interpretation. No genetic testing or variant is reported, so the variants table is empty. The only age is the age at presentation ('5-week-old'), recorded as age at last evaluation; no age at diagnosis is stated. 'no discharge' around the umbilicus was recorded as an excluded feature but not mapped to the checklist item 'absence of pus formation' (discharge is not the same as pus). Omphalitis was not also counted under 'skin or soft tissue infections', and the palatal ulcer/perforation (mucosal) was not counted under necrotic skin ulcers. Background statements about LAD in general (perianal ulcers, absence of pus) are not about this patient and were not used. Country not stated for the patient (only author affiliations in India). No contradictions found.
